notes.title: Steam Deck Support Information
notes.content:
Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos features full Steam Deck support! Throughout the game's development, the Steam Deck was a primary target hardware for us, and we took great care to ensure its optimal performance.

We recommend adjusting the graphics quality in the settings menu from the default "Medium" to "Low". While "Medium" will run at around 30 FPS, selecting "Low" will provide a smoother experience at around 60 FPS.

If you encounter any issues with our Steam Deck support, please feel free to contact us directly at getintheboxstudios@gmail.com.
